events.body:
## Context

BLT-Mayo (`blt-mayo/`) is rated **Bronze** on [Waypoint](https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/?q=blt-mayo): it meets 79% of the checklist that applies to it. Waypoint rates every BLT project daily against the same checklist (`blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py`): **bronze** is the basics, **silver** means it runs, **gold** means it is looked after. This issue lists what is left for gold.

## What to do

### Bronze (the basics: a README, a description, a licence and a logo)

- **Licence file.** Add a LICENSE file to the folder (most BLT projects are AGPL-3.0; copy the repository root's LICENSE).

### Silver (it runs: tests in CI, an automatic deploy, a live site and steps to run it)

- **README links the live site.** Put the live site's address near the top of the README (`**Live Site:** https://mayo.owaspblt.org/`).

### Gold (it is looked after: the BLT theme, a contributing guide, recent commits, several contributors and triaged issues)

- **Contributing guide.** Add CONTRIBUTING.md (or a Contributing section in the README): how to set up, test, and open a pull request on git.owaspblt.org, linking the root CONTRIBUTING.md and AI_POLICY.md.

## Notes

- `compare`, `review`, `bundle`, `export` and `blt-submit` are stubs that print "planned for Week N"; say so in the README (the site already does).
- The README's "35 tests passed / 85.91% coverage" is a hand-written snapshot; replace it with how to run the tests and coverage, or generate it.
- The README's Source Code link still points at the old separate repository; point it at https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/tree/main/blt-mayo.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Licence file
- [ ] README links the live site
- [ ] Contributing guide
- [ ] Waypoint shows `blt-mayo` as Gold after the next daily refresh

## How to test locally

```bash
curl -s https://waypoint.owaspblt.org/forge_data.json -o /tmp/forge_data.json
python3 blt-waypoint/scripts/ratings.py /tmp/forge_data.json --report | grep -w blt-mayo
scripts/ci/test.sh blt-mayo
```

The report reads your checkout, so it shows the new rating before the change is merged.
